svg.title: Pointer size against pointee size
svg.desc: Three rows, each a pointer and the object it points at. In every row a blue stack box holds an address and is marked sizeof(p) == 8, with an arrow to the bytes of its object, tinted teal. char* status_ptr holds 0x7ffd…a00 and points at status, one byte, 41, reading as the character A. int* altitude_ptr holds 0x7ffd…a04 and points at altitude_m, four bytes, 78 00 00 00, reading as 120. double* voltage_ptr holds 0x7ffd…a08 and points at voltage, eight bytes, 33 33 33 33 33 33 26 40, reading as 11.1. Each pointer is 8 bytes; the objects are 1, 4 and 8 bytes.

text.style: font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;font-weight:600;font-stretch:normal;font-size:32px;font-family:'Fira Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;-inkscape-font-specification:'Fira Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif, Semi-Bold';font-variant-ligatures:normal;font-variant-caps:normal;font-variant-numeric:normal;font-variant-east-asian:normal;text-anchor:middle;fill:#1b1b1b

g.text: every pointer is 8 bytes, whatever it points at

text.style: font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;font-weight:normal;font-stretch:normal;font-size:26.6667px;font-family:'Fira Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;-inkscape-font-specification:'Fira Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif, Normal';font-variant-ligatures:normal;font-variant-caps:normal;font-variant-numeric:normal;font-variant-east-asian:normal;text-anchor:middle;fill:#555555

g.text: the type decides what the dereference reads, not how big the pointer is
